name: SPS Modules Activities Report
query:
SELECT
    module.module_name AS `Module Name`,
    COUNT(combined_tasks.name) AS `Total Tasks`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN combined_tasks.task_type = 'Bug' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Bug`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN combined_tasks.task_type = 'New Request' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Request`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN combined_tasks.task_type = 'Script' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Script`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN combined_tasks.task_type = 'Query' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Query Report`,
    -- Calculate Bug Percentage (Safely)
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN combined_tasks.task_type = 'Bug' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(combined_tasks.name), 0)) * 100, 2) AS `Bug %% of Tasks`
FROM
    `tabSPS Module` AS module
LEFT JOIN
    `tabModule Child Table` AS moduleTab ON module.name = moduleTab.module
LEFT JOIN (
    -- This combines both current and old tasks into one stream
    SELECT name, task_type, creation, status FROM `tabSPS Operation Task`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT name, task_type, creation, status FROM `tabSPS Operation Ticket` 
) AS combined_tasks ON moduleTab.parent = combined_tasks.name

WHERE
    -- Checking for NULL or Empty strings first to avoid the comparison if not needed
    (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR combined_tasks.creation >= %(from_date)s)
    AND 
    (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR combined_tasks.creation <= %(to_date)s)
    AND
    combined_tasks.status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY
    module.module_name
ORDER BY
    `Total Tasks` DESC;

name: Modules Activities
query:
SELECT
    modulesTab.parent,
    modules.module_name,
    modulesTab.module,
    COUNT(modules.module_name)
   
    
FROM
    `tabModule Child Table` AS modulesTab
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSPS Module` AS modules on modules.name = modulesTab.module
GROUP BY modules.module_name
    ;
